item.text:
Refactored the graph layer to be more extensible by making graph construction explicit instead of hardcoding “undirected graph from `int[][]`”.

The main additions are [GraphType.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphType.java), [Edge.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/Edge.java), and [GraphBuilder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphBuilder.java). [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/Graph.java) now carries graph-type metadata and delegates construction through the builder, which makes it straightforward to support directed graphs or alternate build flows later. [ArticulationPointAnalysis.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/ArticulationPointAnalysis.java) now also validates that it is only run against undirected graphs, so future analyses can declare their own graph requirements cleanly.

Verification passed with `javac *.java && java ArticulationPoints`, and the output remains `1 4`.
